thread:
deploy-bot: INCIDENT PAGE created for incident 2123456799 — private VPC cluster 'acme-prod' reported high GPU queue. Paging on-call for infra-sre.

jen: Pager here — acme-prod cluster in us-west-2 hitting sustained GPU utilization 98% for 12m, request queue growing ~450 -> 1.2k. Autoscaler not scaling beyond 12 nodes; pool max is 12. Seeing node bootstrap timeouts. Customers impacted: realtime inference latency >5s and tail errors. 

marco: On it. Jumping into cluster. Any immediate customer-facing mitigations? If we can reroute a portion of traffic to hosted fallback models, we should.

priya: FYI acme SRE already DM'd us — they've started throttling non-critical jobs but still hitting backlog. They're asking for ETA.

jen: Good. First mitigation: increase pool max to 20 if ETA to bootstrap is <15m. If not, manual node add via infra playbook.

autoscale-bot: autoscaler alert: scale_down_disabled=false, current_nodes=12, max_nodes=12, scale_recommendation=+8. API rate limit observed against provider (429s) during recent scale attempts.

alex: Provider 429s are from parallel provisioning calls. We hit provider per-subnet attach limit, kernel: "ENI limit reached" in some node bootstrap logs. Might need to stagger the calls.

jen: Show the failing bootstrap logs.

marco: Pasting relevant logs: ```
kubelet: error creating device plugin: timed out
cloud-init: failed to fetch https://packages.redwood-inference.local/ca-image.tar.gz: 504
kube-proxy: network plugin reported "attachment rejected: subnet resource quotas"
node-controller: registration failed: http 500 from control-plane
```

jen: Looks like two issues: image pull/timeouts and provider ENI/quota. For short term: 1) Increase pool max to 20 to allow scale attempts (but may hit ENI limits). 2) Start manual provisioning of 4 nodes via console in a different subnet with spare ENI capacity. 3) Reroute 30% of traffic to hosted-fallback in us-east to reduce pressure.

priya: I'll message the customer that we're actively provisioning extra capacity and enabling a fallback route — ETA ~25m. Will offer SLA credit if sustained >30m.

autoscale-bot: attempted_scale: +4 nodes at 2123456820 -> provider returned 429, retry scheduled.

marco: I can do manual create for 3 nodes in spare-subnet-b and one in spare-subnet-c. Doing now — copying commands: ```
# create node via infra console CLI
infractl node create --cluster acme-prod --subnet spare-subnet-b --type gpu-rtx6000 --image ca-2026-03-10
```

jen: Thx. Also: reduce non-critical queue by adjusting routing rule: `route: inference.v1 -> weight 70% acme-prod, 30% hosted-fallback` — Ajdusting now.

alex: Applied routing change. Traffic shift started, latency for acme-prod down from 5.4s median to 3.1s but queue still present. Hosted-fallback token usage will increase — notify billing/cost team later.

marco: Manual node create step 1/4 succeeded; node registered as `acme-prod-node-13` but Kubelet reports container runtime OOM on start. Investigating image unpack errors — registry throttling maybe.

jen: If registry throttling, we can try alternate image mirror or pre-pull smaller base. Marco, can you try `--image ca-2026-03-10-slim`?

marco: Trying slim image now. Also bumping node bootstrap timeout on controller to 20m.

autoscale-bot: provider quota check shows free ENIs in spare-subnet-b: 6, spare-subnet-c: 2. Current attach attempts: 4 pending.

marco: Slim image boots, node 14 registered. Two more nodes booting. Queue growth rate has slowed from +400/min to +80/min after routing change.

jen: Good. Next: create incident channel, set severity, timeline, assign follow-ups. Priya own customer comms. Marco own infra: root cause triage (ENI limits + registry throttling). Alex own routing/fallback telemetry + cost analysis.

priya: Created incidents/acme-prod-vpc-burst in product updates and messaged customer. They asked for root cause once stable.

jen: Ops note for postmortem: autoscaler shouldn't bind to single-subnet quotas; need cross-subnet fallback logic. Also improve provider 429 backoff exponential jitter and consider prewarming nodes for customers with bursty patterns.

marco: Adding quick patch: autoscaler will check provider ENI headroom before scaling and stagger create calls by 30s. I'll open PR.

alex: Also let's add a temporary throttle on non-critical job queue at the ingress so backpressure doesn't cascade. I put a 15qps limit on batch jobs.

autoscale-bot: scale_event: manual +3 nodes completed at 2123456860. Current_nodes=15.

jen: Monitoring — queue now at 420 and trending down. Latency for critical paths back to ~1.2s. Customer reports partial recovery.

priya: Customer acknowledged recovery and thanks team. They want a post-incident writeup and timeline.

jen: Great work. Creating incident timeline docs and assigning postmortem owners: marco write infra timeline, alex routing metrics, priya customer timeline. I'll schedule a 1-hour postmortem review tomorrow.

marco: Filing infra ticket: INF-2123 for cross-subnet fallback + ENI headroom checks.

jen: Closing pager for now, keep monitoring for 2h, escalate if regressions. :thumbsup:
